content.text:
DocGen の GitHub 動線を実装しました。Deptrac 側は、ご判断どおり専用キーがないので手を付けていません。

## 追加したもの

**リポジトリURLの取得**（`src/DocGen/Config/RepositoryUrl.php` 新規）
- 各パッケージの `composer.json` から `support.source` → `homepage` の順に読む。絶対 http(s) のみ採用し、`git@…` や `git://` は「リンクできない値」として無視。
- `doc.yaml` に `repository:` を追加。プロジェクト側パッケージの宣言を上書きする（vendor パッケージは常に自身の宣言を使う）。不正な値は `Invalid repository: …` で拒否。

**掲出（`src/DocGen/Render/RepositoryLink.php` 新規）**
- 全ページのトップバー（テーマトグロの隣）にホスト名リンク: `github.com`
- パッケージページ先頭に `Repository github.com/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit` の relation 行

このリポジトリ自身の `composer.json` に `homepage` / `support.source` / `support.issues` / `support.docs` を追加したので、`doc.yaml` は無変更のままリンクが出ます。6つの `composer.lock.php-8.x` はどれも `composer validate --strict` が通ることを確認済み（content-hash 対象キーではないため）。

## ついでに直したバグ

`--diff` 実行時に `base_url` が消えていました。`DiffWorkspace::configFor()` が `baseUrl` を渡さず、`ProjectDiffer::diff()` も head モデルの `baseUrl` を新モデルに引き継いでいなかったためです。つまり `docs-preview.yml` が `--diff` と `--base-url` を併用して生成する PR プレビューは、canonical リンクも OG タグも og-image も出ていませんでした。両方通すようにしたので、実測で `<link rel="canonical" href="https://example.github.io/project/pr/7/">` と `og:url`、`assets/og-image.png` が出るようになっています。

## 検証

- `composer lint`（format:check / phpstan / compat / loc-guard / tree-guard / deptrac）と `composer test:unit` はすべて green
- 実際にサイトを生成してトップバーとパッケージページのリンクをブラウザで目視確認（スクショ確認済み）
- ページキャッシュの run ダイジェストに `repository` を追加したので、URL を変えた次回実行で全ページが書き直されます

ドキュメントは `docs/doc-gen.md`（`repository` 設定 + 「Back to the Repository」節）、`skills/setup-toolkit-doc-gen/`（SKILL.md の設定表・逆方向の導線、doc.yaml テンプレート）を更新しました。

コミットはまだしていません。`main` に直接コミットしますか？

**Deptracについて**: レイヤーに `description` のような専用キーはありません。ただ `layers[].attributes` という自由なマップは 0.24 と 4.6.2 の両方で受け付けられる（実際に analyse を通して確認）ので、もし後で気が変わったら `attributes: {description: ...}` が唯一の互換な置き場所になります。

content.content:
f1abf6822a90babf02dda91b9fc73b4c9a4470ae
Forbid expecting the exceptions that mean the code is broken

A test that writes expectException(LogicException::class) asserts that
broken code fails. That is true of every program, so the case proves
nothing about the class under test and belongs deleted rather than
fixed. NoBrokenCodeExpectationRule reports it, and says so.

The taxonomy is the one ForbidBroadCatchRule already keeps out of catch
blocks: the LogicException family is a programmer error, the Error
family is an engine failure, and expectException is a catch in disguise,
so what may not be handled may not be expected either. Throwable joins
them for a different reason — it matches every failure at once, so a
passing expectation cannot tell the failure the test meant to trigger
from a typo in the test itself. The RuntimeException family stays
testable, because those are the failures a caller is expected to handle,
and the root Exception is left alone so that a documented contract
extending it can still be expected.

Both expectException() and expectExceptionObject() are checked, whether
called through $this, self, static, or parent, and only where the
expected type is statically known: a dynamic class-string argument or an
object without a single known class is not reported. The rule applies
across the Tests\ namespace, since the construct exists nowhere else.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
---
1e4d7b641697678a642fe430bd19f9af461ef5c9
Keep in AGENTS.md only what the repository cannot say itself

Branching is the one thing an agent cannot infer here: this project is
developed on main alone and takes no pull requests, so a branch cut out
of habit before committing strands the work. The file says so now.

The architecture table and the directory listing repeated what src/,
tests/, and the config files at the root already show, in a copy that
has to be edited whenever either of them moves, and the forbidden words
section repeated what PHPStan and TreeGuard already report at the point
of the violation. Both are gone.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
---
dc9e843b1c40d3fdb80666dc4e32fadf2a5db79c
Ban the names that describe the task instead of the code

Evidence, Outcome, and Probe name what an agent was doing — collecting
proof, recording a result, poking at a system — rather than anything the
project models, and they arrive whenever a type is written before its
responsibility is decided. They join the forbidden class-like suffixes,
and the source rules deny the file names that carry them, the way the
generic suffixes already banned there are denied from both sides.

A scripts directory is the same habit one level up: a place to drop what
nothing runs and nothing analyzes. It is now denied everywhere, which
TreeGuard could not express before, because it could only be pointed at
a source root. The project root is a scannable path of its own now: it
is addressed and reported as ".", carries no path segment so that only
"." and "**" match it, and the directories below it keep their plain
root-relative names, so a rule written for src/** matches the same
directories whether the scan starts at the root or inside it. Depth and
subtree totals no longer count the matched directory as one of its own
descendants.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

of the violation. Both are gone.

Ban the names that describe the task instead of the code

Evidence, Outcome, and Probe name what an agent was doing — collecting
proof, recording a result, poking at a system — rather than anything the
project models, and they arrive whenever a type is written before its
responsibility is decided. They join the forbidden class-like suffixes,
and the source rules deny the file names that carry them, the way the
generic suffixes already banned there are denied from both sides.

A scripts directory is the same habit one level up: a place to drop what
nothing runs and nothing analyzes. It is now denied everywhere, which
TreeGuard could not express before, because it could only be pointed at
a source root. The project root is a scannable path of its own now: it
is addressed and reported as ".", carries no path segment so that only
"." and "**" match it, and the directories below it keep their plain
root-relative names, so a rule written for src/** matches the same
directories whether the scan starts at the root or inside it. Depth and
subtree totals no longer count the matched directory as one of its own
descendants.

git commit -F - <<'MSG'
Link every page back to the repository it documents

A generated site is the read side of a repository, and a reader who
found an answer in it wants the code that answer was read from. Nothing
on a page said where that code lives: the only link out of the site was
the generator's own, in the footer. Every page now carries the host of
the documented repository next to the theme toggle, and a package page
names it in full as a Repository row.

The address is the one a package already declares. support.source is
what composer links a package to its code with, so it is read first, and
homepage stands in where a package declares no source, because it is
then the only address the package offers a reader. Only an absolute http
address is linked — a git@ or git:// source is not one a browser can
follow — and a package that declares neither gets no link rather than a
guess. repository in doc.yaml overrides what the project's own packages
declare, which is the answer where a repository has moved, where the
manifest says nothing, and where the site is generated from a checkout
that is not the published one; a documented dependency keeps its own
address, since it is published from somewhere else entirely. This
package declares its source, issues, and docs now, so its site links
back without configuring anything.

A comparison had been dropping the address the site is published at.
Neither the configuration each revision is analyzed under nor the model
both revisions merge into carried base_url, so every --diff run wrote a
site without canonical links, Open Graph tags, or a preview image — and
that is exactly the run the pull request preview workflow makes, with
--base-url on the command line. Both pass it on now, and the repository
travels the same way.

The digest every page of a run has in common covers the repository, so
changing it rewrites the site instead of serving the previous topbar
from the page cache.
